Autoregressive decoding and masked diffusion decoding are two different approaches used in serving systems to generate text or other data. Autoregressive decoding is a straightforward method where the model generates each element in a sequence based on the previous one. This approach is relatively fast and efficient, but it may not produce the most coherent or contextually relevant output.
